claims.statement: OpenWiki 0.7.2 is declared as the npm dependency openwiki@^0.7.2 in package.json.

The OpenWiki Update workflow runs on manual dispatch and daily at cron 0 8 * * *, runs `openwiki code --update --print`, and opens a pull request on branch openwiki/update titled 'docs: update OpenWiki'.

.mcp.json registers an openwiki MCP server that runs node ./node_modules/openwiki/dist/cli/cli.js with the mcp --host claude arguments, so it must be launched from the repository root after npm install.
.gitignore also excludes credential files (.env, *.pem, *.key, *.p12), graphify-out/, .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, and .opencode/plugins/.

The scheduled OpenWiki Update workflow installs openwiki@0.7.2 with mermaid@11.16.0 and jsdom@29.1.1 globally, runs openwiki code --update --print, removes openwiki/.run.json, and opens a pull request on branch openwiki/update including CLAUDE.md when present.
